title: Pelvic Pain
hpi_narrative: {{patient_name}} is a reproductive-age woman who presents with severe pelvic pain that worsens with sexual activity. The pain is localized to the right adnexal region. Differential for a right adnexal mass in a reproductive-age female is broad and includes ectopic pregnancy, tuboovarian abscess, inflammatory bowel disease, ovarian mass, endometrioma, theca lutein cysts, and germ cell neoplasms. Imaging and appropriate surgical consultation are required.
chief_complaint: Severe pelvic pain, worse with intercourse

stacks.label: Physical Exam: General Appearance
stacks.finding: The general examination is extremely useful to determine how sick the patient looks.

stacks.label: Physical Exam: Chest / Lungs
stacks.finding: It's important to rule out any lung issues such as metastatic disease.

stacks.label: Physical Exam: Abdomen
stacks.finding: Abdominal pathology can present as pelvic pain. Example: inflammatory bowel disease.

stacks.label: Physical Exam: Genitalia
stacks.finding: Important since the source of pain is coming from the pelvic area.

stacks.label: CT/MRI/US abdomen/pelvis
stacks.finding: CT would give diagnosis of endometrioma. Pelvic US (transvaginal) is typically first-line.

stacks.label: Laparotomy / Laparoscopy / Consult OB/GYN
stacks.finding: The endometrioma should be surgically removed. OB/GYN consult is appropriate.

stacks.label: Instruct patient, smoking cessation
stacks.finding: One of the most important things patients can do for their health is to stop smoking.

stacks.label: Advise patient, no illegal drug use
stacks.finding: Good opportunity to discuss the medical effects of cannabis use.

physical_exam.general: Patient in moderate distress from pelvic pain.
physical_exam.abdominal: Lower abdominal tenderness. Pelvic pathology can present with abdominal symptoms.
physical_exam.genitourinary: Right adnexal mass. Pelvic exam indicated — source of pain is pelvic. Cervical motion tenderness assessment needed.

decoys.label: Appendectomy
decoys.reason_wrong: While appendicitis can present with RLQ pain, imaging shows adnexal mass consistent with endometrioma. Gynecologic consult is correct.

decoys.label: Broad-spectrum antibiotics (without culture)
decoys.reason_wrong: No evidence of infection. Tuboovarian abscess is on the differential but imaging should guide therapy.

decoys.label: Discharge home without follow-up
decoys.reason_wrong: Patient has a surgical adnexal mass requiring OB/GYN consultation and likely operative management.

teach_me_steps.reasoning: Transvaginal US is first-line for adnexal masses. CT or MRI also acceptable. Characterize the mass before intervention.
Endometriomas require surgical removal. Laparoscopy is the standard approach.
Smoking cessation and substance use counseling are appropriate preventive measures when treating reproductive-age patients.

case_summary: Right adnexal mass in reproductive-age woman with severe pelvic pain and dyspareunia. Imaging (US/CT/MRI) → endometrioma. Treatment: laparotomy/laparoscopy by OB/GYN. Preventive counseling for smoking cessation and drug use.
